artboards.role: Forno Rosso pizzeria marketing home page: header/nav, hero, delivery promo banner, featured (Chef Recommendations) menu grid, brand-story/trust-content section, footer. The linked node is a single FRAME, not a CANVAS of several artboards, so there is only one screen to review. This story's scope is the brand-story section (story-section / 'Our Passion for the Perfect Crust', its 3-item trust/feature list, and its two-photo image collage) — the rest of the page is mapped for continuity with MANOJ-ADMIN-PROJECT-STORY-004 (header/hero/delivery-banner shipped) and MANOJ-ADMIN-PROJECT-STORY-006 (featured-grid shipped).

open_questions.topic: StorySection has no responsive design below its fixed 1440px, two-column layout
open_questions.detail: story-section (6:108) fixes a 600px text column and a 600px, two-photo image collage side by side with an 80px gap, inside 80px side padding on a 1440px canvas. No tablet or mobile stacking is drawn anywhere, and the two 292px-wide collage photos (6:134, 6:135) would not fit side by side once the column drops much below ~660px.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Reuse the app's existing useIsMobileViewport hook/pattern (src/features/site/useIsMobileViewport.ts, 640px breakpoint): below that width, stack to a single column with the text block (eyebrow, heading, paragraph, feature list) first, then the two collage photos below it, stacked vertically full-width rather than side by side.

options.label: Single column below 640px: text block first, then the two collage photos stacked vertically below — extrapolated from the app's existing mobile breakpoint, not drawn in the frame
Single column below 640px: image collage first as a visual hook, text block below
Ship the two-column 600/600 layout fixed at the designed width only, matching the frame pixel-for-pixel with no reflow below it

open_questions.topic: The two story photos have no authored alt text
open_questions.detail: Nodes 6:134 and 6:135 are both generically named 'Rectangle' in Figma; the frame supplies no accessible description for either photo, only the pixels themselves (a chef hand-stretching dough, and a pizza baking inside a lit wood-fired oven).
open_questions.arc_assumption: Author descriptive alt text from the rendered imagery: 'A chef hand-stretching sourdough pizza dough over a floured countertop' for 6:134, and 'A wood-fired pizza baking inside a lit stone hearth oven' for 6:135, rather than leaving alt text empty or generic.

open_questions.topic: '900°F Stone Hearth Wood Oven' feature uses a compass icon
open_questions.detail: FeatureListItem icons are star (tomatoes), shield (mozzarella), and compass (wood oven, 6:595) — compass has no obvious semantic link to an oven or fire, unlike the other two pairings.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Render the icon exactly as designed (lucide 'compass') rather than substituting a flame/oven icon; unlike the hero badge's icon (see hero-badge-icon-name) this isn't an obvious mislabel, just an unusual pairing, so the frame is trusted as authoritative.

open_questions.topic: Whether featured-section and story-section headings share one SectionHeading component
open_questions.detail: featured-section uses a brand-red uppercase eyebrow with a short rule under the title; story-section uses a brand-green uppercase eyebrow with no rule. Layout (eyebrow above serif title) is otherwise identical.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Model both as one shared SectionHeading component with eyebrowTone ('accent' | 'brand') and showRule props. Carried over from MANOJ-ADMIN-PROJECT-STORY-006's mapping of the same frame.

open_questions.topic: No icon assets are exported for the vector icons this story needs (star, shield, compass)
open_questions.detail: figma-assets.json only lists photographic fills (hero, 4 menu cards, 2 story photos); star, shield and compass are vector node names that match lucide-react icon ids exactly, same as every other icon in this frame.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Introduce lucide-react as the icon source and wrap it in a local Icon(name) component rather than hand-authoring new SVGs, since the naming match is too exact to be coincidental. Carried over from MANOJ-ADMIN-PROJECT-STORY-006's mapping of the same frame.

open_questions.topic: Supplied component catalogue said greenfield, but the repo already has site components from earlier stories
open_questions.detail: The task prompt states 'no existing UI components in this project', but src/features/site already contains SiteHeader, PrimaryNav, NavLink, BrandLogo, DeliveryIndicator (STORY-004) and FeaturedSection, FeaturedGrid, MenuItemCard (STORY-006). StorySection, FeatureList, FeatureListItem and StoryImageCollage — this story's actual deliverables — have no equivalent anywhere in the repo, so they are genuinely new either way.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Follow the stated catalogue literally: every node in component_map above is marked status: proposed_new, with no exceptions. Where matching code already lives in src/features/site (from prior stories, all out-of-scope for this story), that is called out in the relevant entry's notes so an implementer reuses/extends it instead of duplicating it — but status itself is not overridden.

open_questions.topic: Whether hero CTAs and card 'Add to Order' buttons share one Button component
open_questions.detail: Hero has a primary red-fill button with a trailing arrow icon and an outline button with no icon; each MenuItemCard has a dark-fill button with a leading plus icon. All three share size, radius (8px) and type style but differ in fill/border/icon placement.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Model all three as one shared Button component with variant ('primary' | 'outline' | 'dark') and icon/iconPosition props. Carried over from MANOJ-ADMIN-PROJECT-STORY-004's mapping of the same frame. Out of scope for this story (no button appears in story-section).

open_questions.topic: Header still has a designed 'Cart' affordance that isn't built
open_questions.detail: The frame shows both a plain 'Cart' nav link (6:18) and a separate cart icon button with a live-count badge (6:22) in the header. STORY-004 shipped SiteHeader with only Home/Our Menu and no CartButton at all.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Leave this gap for whichever story adds a cart/checkout flow. Not part of this story's scope, carried forward for continuity only.

open_questions.topic: Hero eyebrow badge's icon layer is misnamed relative to its glyph
open_questions.detail: Node 6:679 is named 'fire-extinguisher' but the rendered PNG shows a flame glyph, and 'Authentic Neapolitan Woodfired' pairs naturally with fire/flame, not an extinguisher.
